Broad losses, weak participation and observed liquidity outflows outweigh the latest hour of ETH stabilization. Negative funding and fearful sentiment leave room for sharp relief rallies without establishing recovery. Upside transmission into altcoins remains weak and unconfirmed. These are non-binding descriptive forecasts, not execution permissions; the Cycle Navigator is contextual rather than an independent confirming vote.
